answer:
The Windows documentation gives the minimum as NVIDIA driver 551.61: "NVIDIA 551.61 or newer Drivers if you have an NVIDIA card" [ollama/docs/windows.md].

The general hardware page lists a different figure: "Ollama supports Nvidia GPUs with compute capability 5.0+ and driver version 550 and newer." [ollama/docs/gpu.md]. It also says GPUs with compute capability 5.0 through 6.2 need more: "Nvidia GPUs with compute capability 5.0 through 6.2 require driver version 570 or newer." [ollama/docs/gpu.md]

The documents don't explain the difference between 551.61 and 550. For Windows, I'd go with 551.61 and check the newer requirement if your card has compute capability 5.0 to 6.2.
